user.title: Window Advisor
user.description: Shared inputs for every room. Values were pre-filled from what was found in your setup.

data.ignore_idle_rooms: Only list rooms that need it

data_description.weather_entity: Must provide an hourly forecast. It's used to tell when opening or closing will help next.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: A real outdoor sensor (or a median of several) is far more accurate than the weather entity.
data_description.target_temperature_entity: An input_number, number or sensor. Leave empty to get a built-in number entity instead.
data_description.target_delta_entity: How far the indoor temperature may drift from the target before advice kicks in. Leave empty for a built-in number entity.
data_description.forecast_interval: How often the hourly forecast is fetched (seconds). Temperature changes are evaluated immediately regardless.
data_description.ignore_idle_rooms: Alert-fatigue fix. When on, the whole-home advice only lists rooms whose own advisor recommends the action. When off, it behaves like the original templates and lists every room whose window isn't in the majority's state, even rooms that are fine.
data_description.discovery_repairs: Raise a repair issue when an area gains window contacts and a temperature sensor but has no room yet.
